blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—San Miguel Beer overcame a 20-point deficit in the fourth quarter to stun NLEX, 135-133, but missed out on the No. 1 spot in Group A of the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup on Wednesday at Ynares Center here. A goaltending violation called on Robert Bolick for touching the net while George King was going for a basket with 5.3 seconds left proved to be the difference as the Beermen snatched victory away from the Road Warriors, who were enjoying a comfortable lead.
